says: A send_chunks whose operands sit just under INPUT_BYTES never gets an answer: its ok or err answer echoes every item, so the answer row passes the ledger's 2,000,000-byte cap, the writer's turn fails with LedgerError refused too_big, the Cmd stays owed for good, and every later mail to that name waits behind it. Fixed in the same pull request by the fix round of 2026-11-15: a send_chunks answer echoes only `{type, to, as}`, on ok and on err, and L12 now generates operands a few hundred bytes either side of INPUT_BYTES and requires exactly one answer each time.
proof: L12's operands case changed to 1,777 items of 1,100 bytes (1,999,852 bytes, 148 under the cap) gave no answer and one owed Cmd. The echo in Runner.ts kept job.cmd whole for send_chunks, while oversized refuses only operands over INPUT_BYTES, which equals ROW_BYTES (Children.ts:24), the ledger's row cap (ledgerStore.ts:114).
cost: One chunked send near the cap stalls every later letter its writer sends that reader, with no answer and no error the program can see.
